text:
Predicates:
PublishingHouse(x) ::: x is a publishing house.
Specializes(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.
ForeignLiterature(x) ::: x is foreign literature.
English(x) ::: x is in English.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x is published by y.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x is translated from y.
Italian(x) ::: x is Italian.
NewVesselPress(x) ::: x is New Vessel Press.
NeapolitanChronicles(x) ::: x is Neapolitan Chronicles.
PalaceOfFlies(x) ::: x is Palace of Flies.
HarryPotter(x) ::: x is Harry Potter.
Premises:
PublishingHouse(NewVesselPress) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house.
Specializes(NewVesselPress, ForeignLiterature) ::: New Vessel Press specializes in translating foreign literature into English.
∀x (PublishedBy(x, NewVesselPress) → English(x)) ::: All of New Vessel Press's published books are in English.
Book(NeapolitanChronicles) ∧ PublishedBy(NeapolitanChronicles, NewVesselPress) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press.
TranslatedFrom(NeapolitanChronicles, Italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
Book(PalaceOfFlies) ∧ PublishedBy(PalaceOfFlies, NewVesselPress) ::: Palace of Flies is a book published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
PublishedBy(HarryPotter, NewVesselPress) ::: Harry Potter was published by New Vessel Press.
